text: Clause 4.2 (Footfall Analytics). The Provider shall convert the walking paths of shoppers captured across the airport duty-free concourse into zone-by-zone occupancy heatmaps for merchandising review. Path data may be transmitted to and processed at off-premises facilities. Requests under this clause shall be handled on an expedited, top-priority basis.

text: Article 2.4. The Supplier shall fit floor, tabletop and wall planes to each depth-sensor frame from the tablets that overlay BIM models on construction progress, so virtual building elements can be anchored to them. Depth frames shall be processed at the construction site. Moderate estimation fidelity is sufficient.

text: Clause 4.2. The Provider shall examine every lot of titanium landing-gear fasteners returned from overhaul, rejecting any bolt with damaged or stripped thread flanks, leftover machining burrs, or thread pitch that departs from drawing tolerance. Inspection shall be carried out at the tightest measurement fidelity the Provider offers. These lots shall be processed ahead of all other queued work, as the affected aircraft remain grounded until release.

Frames can be processed at your remote data centre.
